verdicts.title: An invalid data-bs-target or href selector throws, so a dismiss trigger closes nothing
verdicts.evidence: In Bootstrap, js/src/util/component-functions.js:25 calls SelectorEngine.getElementFromSelector(this). For href='./inbox.html', getSelector (selector-engine.js:20,29) returns './inbox.html', and querySelector (:41) throws SyntaxError before the `|| this.closest(...)` fallback, so the alert stays open. In the engine, /home/user/veneer/src/browser/helpers.ts:721-723 swallows the error into [], and resolveDismiss (helpers.ts:185-188) then uses closest('.alert'). The routes at /home/user/veneer/src/browser/plugins.ts:43,225,265,349 (alert, modal, offcanvas, toast) all close the host. The only proof, helpers.test.ts:967-968, pins [] without an oracle reading, and the departure table (/home/user/veneer/guides/veneer.md:720-745) has no row for this. Fix: either make resolveTargets report a selector failure so resolveDismiss skips the closest() fallback, or add a departure row consumed by an oracle case driving `<div class="alert"><a href="./inbox.html" data-bs-dismiss="alert">`.

verdicts.title: An invalid selector in an element option (parent, container, boundary, reference, target) throws at construction
verdicts.evidence: In Bootstrap, getElement('#') runs querySelector(parseSelector('#')). The id regex does not match a bare '#', so it throws SyntaxError inside _configAfterMerge, before _typeCheckConfig, and the constructor fails. In the engine, /home/user/veneer/src/browser/helpers.ts:291-293 returns undefined, and helpers.ts:346, 499, 546, 586, and 598 fall back to no parent, body, or the default. The mistyped-input row (/home/user/veneer/guides/veneer.md:739) is scoped to toast::dismiss.delay with value TypeError, and helpers.test.ts:686-767 consumes it only for that leaf. The guide's API table line 107 documents the helper but is not a departure row. /home/user/veneer/tests/src/browser/helpers.test.ts:773 pins undefined without an oracle reading. Fix: match Bootstrap by refusing construction, or add a row consumed by an oracle case such as `<div class="collapse" data-bs-parent="#">`.

verdicts.title: Transition completion fires on the element's first own transitionend of any property
verdicts.evidence: Bootstrap's handler (js/src/util/index.js:240-248) completes on the first transitionend whose target is the element. The engine (/home/user/veneer/src/browser/helpers.ts:946-948) waits for Promise.allSettled over every own CSSTransition, bounded by the first listed duration (helpers.ts:935-945). The difference shows only when the first listed duration is longer than a later one. For `transform 1s, visibility .2s`, Bootstrap completes at about 0.2 s and the engine at about 1 s. Bootstrap's own sheet has no multi-property transition on an awaited host, so this needs author CSS. All proofs at /home/user/veneer/tests/src/browser/helpers.test.ts:1100-1305 use a single property, and the transition-wait row (guides/veneer.md:743) covers only the synthetic event. Fix: resolve on the first own transition's finish (Promise.race over the finished promises), or add a row consumed by a two-property oracle case.

verdicts.title: A cancelled transition still waits for the emulated bound
verdicts.evidence: Bootstrap listens only for transitionend (index.js:250) and otherwise completes at the emulated duration plus 5 ms (index.js:251-255). The engine resolves when a cancelled animation's finished promise rejects, through allSettled (/home/user/veneer/src/browser/helpers.ts:947), so completion events come earlier. /home/user/veneer/guides/veneer.md:640 states this in prose, but no row covers it in the table at :720-745, whose preamble (:718) claims to list every deliberate difference. /home/user/veneer/tests/src/browser/helpers.test.ts:1298-1300 pins only the engine side. Fix: add a transition-cancel departure row consumed by an oracle reading of Bootstrap's completion time after animation.cancel(), or ignore cancellation and keep the padded timer.

verdicts.title: A delegated trigger that is not an HTML element, such as <svg data-bs-dismiss="toast">, still routes
verdicts.evidence: In Bootstrap, delegation matches any querySelectorAll result (event-handler.js:104-118). isDisabled (util/index.js:126-139) finds no disabled property on an SVG element and no disabled attribute, so it returns false, and component-functions.js:25 falls back to closest('.toast') and hides the toast. In the engine, /home/user/veneer/src/browser/Veneer.ts:195 returns when isBrowserElement(trigger) is false, and /home/user/veneer/src/browser/validators.ts:11-24 accepts only HTMLElement. The guide's Browser entry chapter (guides/veneer.md:614-660) never restricts triggers to HTML elements, and no row covers this. Fix: accept realm Element triggers in Veneer#route (with hosts still checked by isBrowserElement), or add a row consumed by an oracle case.

verdicts.title: Outside the claims: a selector failure in a toggle trigger (modal, offcanvas, collapse, tab) diverges from Bootstrap's throw
verdicts.evidence: Referral to the orchestrator; I did not rule on it. Bootstrap's toggle handlers call getElementFromSelector before preventDefault, so a throw would also skip navigation. Bootstrap's tab _activate writes the active class before resolving the pane. The engine returns [] from /home/user/veneer/src/browser/helpers.ts:721-723, consumed at plugins.ts:89,211,248 and Tab.ts:135,145. Probe: in both realms, click `<a href="./page.html" data-bs-toggle="modal">` and a tab `<a class="nav-link" href="./x" data-bs-toggle="tab">`, then record defaultPrevented, the class and aria writes on the tab, and reportError counts.

questions: Q1 Selector failures: when data-bs-target, href, or an element option holds a selector that fails to parse, repair to Bootstrap's outcome or keep the fallback with departure rows? Recommended: repair the dismiss fallback so a parse failure resolves no host and the alert stays (src/browser/helpers.ts:184-188), and record $::errors rows for the error-only differences (collapse construction loop, js/src/collapse.js:66-76; element options such as data-bs-parent="#", js/src/util/index.js:92-94). Rules F1's 4 selector claims and the needs-probe toggle-trigger finding.

Q2 Error-only and teardown differences: keep the engine's quieter behavior and record each as a departure row instead of reproducing Bootstrap's throws and leaked listeners? Recommended: rows for alert (close after completion, second close during fade, destroy in close listener, orphan trigger), button (toggle after destroy), carousel (pointer-event class, dragstart listeners, touch timeout, completion errors), dropdown (no-menu error), modal (show during backdrop fade-out, which js/src/modal.js:252-256 undoes in Bootstrap), offcanvas (toggle beside an instance-less shown panel), scrollspy (disposal smooth handler, shared smooth target, dropup item), and toast (orphan trigger).

Q3 Dropdown virtual-element reference (dropdown.spec.js:537): CSS anchor positioning needs an element. Recommended: refuse by type and record a row for the silent toggle fallback (src/browser/Dropdown.ts:120-124); alternative: throw a VeneerError.

Q4 Dropdown positioning: recommended repair of placement-attribute timing (defer the first write past shown.bs.dropdown, Dropdown.ts:142-143) and of navbar detection (cache at construction, refresh in update, Dropdown.ts:97), and refusal with a row for positioning a static menu whose popperConfig carries modifiers (js/src/dropdown.js:313-324). Confirm?

Q5 Transition completion: recommended repair to the first own transition's finish (src/browser/helpers.ts:946-948) and a row keeping early completion on cancellation, which guides/veneer.md:640 states, against Bootstrap's padded bound (js/src/util/index.js:250-255). Confirm?

Q6 Bootstrap's class API: recommended one refusal sentence at guides/veneer.md:616 for class statics, mutable global defaults (Toast.Default, Tooltip.Default.allowList), the selector-string constructor, toggleEnabled, isShown, and jQuery, plus narrowing guides/veneer.md:718 to identical markup and the data API so factory differences (markup-built replacement :622, REGISTRY_CONFLICT :620, post-destroy no-ops :634, VeneerError messages) stay in prose. Alternative: a row per difference.

Q7 Browser floor: recommended stating the floor that CSS anchor positioning, Array.prototype.findLast, and signal-bound listeners set (near guides/veneer.md:646), refusing Bootstrap's scrollTop fallback (js/src/scrollspy.js:146-147), and refusing the touch-event branch for realms without PointerEvent (src/browser/Swipe.ts:48-65), which deletes the branch and withdraws carousel.spec.js:493, :534, :621 and swipe.spec.js:160 from F5 and F6. Alternative: keep the branch and prove it in frames without PointerEvent.
